title: Quark sector effects and glueball mass sensitivity estimates in Lorentz-violating supersymmetric QCD-like theories
summary: The $N=1$ supersymmetric Yang--Mills--Carroll--Field--Jackiw (SYM--CFJ) model is extended to include the quark sector of supersymmetric quantum chromodynamics (SQCD) in the presence of Lorentz--symmetry violation (LSV). The Lorentz--violating data are carried by a spurion chiral superfield whose components define a purely spacelike background vector $v_μ$ and fermionic bilinears, inducing a topological mass scale in the gauge sector.
